title: Law to ban the fastest class of electric bikes
summary: This bill would prohibit operating class three bicycles with electric assist (those that can reach 25 mph without pedaling) on city streets, in parks and in other public places. Before April 1, 2029, violators would only get a warning, but after that date penalties would rise from $0 for a first violation to up to $100 for later violations within two years. The law would take effect 24 months after enactment.
